pattern: keep an eye on something and come back to me
experience: The user asks the agent to keep watching CI and report when it settles. The agent arms a monitor loop on its own thread instead of a new-thread scheduled task or a blocking wait.
rule: monitor_start: Wake this thread repeatedly to check on something, as a loop ... It ends after maxCycles wakes, at expiresInHours, when you reply with stopSentinel, on monitor_stop, or if the thread is archived.

pattern: an automated wake that finds nothing new
experience: A monitor loop wakes the thread and its check shows CI still running, unchanged. The agent closes the turn with nothing_to_report instead of writing a status message nobody needs.
rule: nothing_to_report: Close an automated turn (scheduled task, monitor loop or event wake) that found nothing the user needs ... notifies no one.
